_doc: RDD brand configuration for the Automation Platform — the SINGLE, non-secret source of brand facts + design tokens the Rendering Engine injects into Components/. This resolves the audit's Design.md/BrandConfig.md contradiction: CLAUDE.md §2 says those Flow-project files must NOT exist here, so the Campaign platform reads brand config from THIS file instead. Credentials are NEVER stored here — they load at runtime from Brands/RDD/.env (git-ignored).
_sources: Values are grounded in APPROVED, in-repo references, not invented (CLAUDE.md §5): (a) approved output Brands/RDD/Campaigns/Weekly/Output/RDD-2026-W31.html — the in-repo reference of record (CLAUDE.md §6.23); (b) CLAUDE.md §6.10/§6.13 (RDD brand orange, approved grid/footer); (c) Brands/RDD/integration/rdd.config.js (BigCommerce mapping); (d) Shared/design-tokens.md (structural scale). Each field carries a confidence tag per 03-Brands MD Files/RDD.md.

darkUrl.source: same asset in both modes (header.html fallback)

designTokens._note: Approved RDD palette from RDD-2026-W31.html + CLAUDE.md §6.10/§6.13. Type scale/radii from Shared/design-tokens.md. Six-digit hex only (design-tokens §6.2).

trust._note: Monochrome text-presentation glyphs only (CLAUDE.md §6.21) — never colour emoji. Reused from approved W29-W31 trust strip.
trust.title: Why Retail Display Direct

product._note: SS/RDD Weekly standard: 18 products per campaign. Overridable per-campaign via campaign.product_count.

bigcommerce._note: Non-secret store-structural mapping. Mirrors Brands/RDD/integration/rdd.config.js. Credentials load from Brands/RDD/.env at runtime. Read-only (GET) only.

klaviyo._note: Non-secret Klaviyo settings for the Draft MVP. Credentials are NEVER stored here — KLAVIYO_API_KEY loads at runtime from `envPath` (git-ignored). NO Klaviyo API calls occur until T4+; this block is inert infrastructure config for T1-T3. Fields tagged 'To be confirmed' are external prerequisites (a verified sending domain + a dedicated test list) per KLAVIYO_MVP_IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md §8.
klaviyo._revisionNote: Pin the current STABLE Klaviyo API revision. CONFIRM against Klaviyo's API changelog before the first API call (T4). Inert until then — no request is made this sprint.

fromEmail.source: user-directed brand sender; same verified sending domain as the account default hello@retaildisplaydirect.com.au (§13.4)

replyToEmail.source: reply_to = brand sender (equivalent to 'Use as reply-to' enabled) (§13.4)

name.note: A dedicated DEMO/test list; resolved to an id at T5/T6.
